meta_title: Roles: Who Can Do What in a VpnHood! MANAGER Project | VpnHood!
meta_description: Give each person on your VpnHood! MANAGER project a role: who only looks, who manages access keys or servers, and who manages the team, plus bots that use MANAGER's API.
title: Roles
lead: Everyone on a VpnHood! MANAGER project has one role, which decides what they can see and change, from only looking at the project to managing its team. Bots, for scripts that use MANAGER's API, get a role the same way.
where_desc: Open [manager_settings] and select [manager_team]. [manager_team_members] lists the people and bots on the project, each with a [manager_role]. Select one to open their page, where you change their role or remove them. Only a [manager_project_admin] or a [manager_project_owner] sees it.
roles_intro: Each role can do everything the one above it can, and more:
role_reader: [manager_project_reader] sees the project: its servers, farms, access keys and usage. It cannot copy an access key, change anything or see the team.
role_token_writer: [manager_access_token_writer] also creates, changes and deletes access keys, and copies them to give out.
role_writer: [manager_project_writer] also adds and installs servers, and manages farms, certificates, server profiles and the project's settings: everything but the team.
role_admin: [manager_project_admin] also manages the team: it adds people and bots, changes their roles and removes them, but cannot make anyone an owner or change an owner's role.
role_owner: [manager_project_owner] also makes people owners, and changes or removes other owners.
add_how: Under [manager_team], select [manager_add_user], enter the email address the person signs in to MANAGER with, and select [manager_ok]. They join as [manager_project_reader]: open their page to give them the role they need. For someone already on the team, MANAGER keeps their role and says so: change it on their page.
add_tell: MANAGER does not email them, so tell them yourself. The project is in their list once they sign in to MANAGER with that address, with Google or with an email and password. Until they open it, the team sees only their email address.
change_how: Open the person's page, edit their [manager_role], choose the new one and select [manager_ok]. A person has one role, so the new one replaces the old.
remove_how: Open their page and select [manager_delete], then [manager_yes]. They lose access to the project, and keep their MANAGER account and their own projects.
owner_desc: Whoever creates a project is its owner, and a project can have several. An owner cannot remove themselves or change their own role, so a project always keeps one.
owner_hand: To hand a project over, make the new person a [manager_project_owner]: they can then change your role or remove you.
bots_what: A bot is a member for a script or a service that uses MANAGER's REST API rather than the web panel. It has a name, a role, and an API key in place of a sign-in.
bots_add: Under [manager_team], select [manager_add_bot], name the bot and select [manager_ok]. MANAGER shows its key once, under [manager_api_key], as the value of an Authorization header: copy it then. The bot joins as [manager_project_reader]: give it the role its work needs, any but [manager_project_owner].
bots_reset: If a key leaks, open the bot's page and select [manager_reset_api_key]: the bot gets a new key, and the old one stops working at once. Deleting the bot stops its key too.
next_api: Call MANAGER's API with your bot's key
